texts: Bevin Coombe is Brindle Coombe's brother.
Bevin Coombe tends the Stilllight Lantern.
The Stilllight station is a hard station.
Bevin Coombe sleeps during the day.
Bevin Coombe walks down the Cove Stair every evening at sunset.

fields.sentence: Bevin Coombe is Brindle Coombe's brother.

review.notes: Exactly the "her sister" shape of Possessive / genitive NP — the copular typing atom plus the opaque Possession (possessed first), which the prompt says covers kinship — and both multi-word names get one whole-name symbol and one Name each. No Symmetric tag is due: "brother" is not asserted mutually by the copula here, and coining a Brother head would be barred.

fields.sentence: Bevin Coombe tends the Stilllight Lantern.

review.notes: "the Stilllight Lantern" correctly takes the name-plus-kind-atom route (the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word), with the surface spelling preserved in the Name string and no modifier genus for stilllight; the present-tense habitual correctly carries no status atom. Patient for the object of "tend" sits on the Patient/Theme boundary (upkeep as applied treatment vs. the unclear-defaults-to-Theme rule) but is defensible as written.

fields.sentence: The Stilllight station is a hard station.

review.notes: Capitalized name plus adjacent lowercase kind noun follows the "the Brindle estuary" pattern exactly — one name symbol, one Name atom, the kind in an ordinary type atom. "hard station" is correctly left unfused (a gradable descriptive adjective, not a term of art), so the split into (Member stilllight station) and (Member stilllight hard) is right, and the individual facts keep 0.99.

fields.sentence: Bevin Coombe sleeps during the day.

q2_gaps: 'during' + a time-span NP ('during the day', 'during the winter'): the During head is defined only for nesting one reified eventuality inside another, and the day-part inventory licensed as a bare Time symbol lists morning / afternoon / evening / night (plus dawn / noon / dusk for bounds) but not 'day' as the daytime counterpart of 'night'
review.notes: No type atom is invented for Bevin Coombe and no status atom is added for the habitual present, both correct. The Experiencer on intransitive 'sleeps' is borderline — it sits between the stative-intransitive branch and the 'when unclear, Agent' fallback, and the set's stative examples are locative/postural and psych states only.

fields.sentence: Bevin Coombe walks down the Cove Stair every evening at sunset.

review.notes: 'every evening' correctly yields the slot atom (Time e evening) plus the implied cycle (Every e 1 day), with no tense atom on the habitual, and 'at sunset' stays a bare day-part-style Time constant. 'down the Cove Stair' takes the surface preposition-named Down oblique, since no named path role fits and a prepositional object never takes a direct-object role.
